_schema.说明: 山海经异兽定义。components 里的键对应代码中的组件注册表（content_loader.py），新增行为=新组件类+注册+此处引用。tags 为预留扩展字段：五行/阴阳/出处卷目（卷目 tag 与 regions.json 对应，供投放匹配）。name/lore 支持两种写法：字符串（所有语言同值）或 {"zh_CN": …, "en_US": …}，缺失语言回退 zh_CN。

字段.name: 显示名（可本地化）
字段.tags: 扩展标签（shanhaijing=山海经, 卷目, 五行等）
字段.components.ai: AI 行为，type 对应 ai.py 注册表

lore.zh_CN: 《南山经》：招摇之山，有兽焉，其状如禺而白耳，伏行人走，其名曰狌狌，食之善走。
lore.en_US: Southern Mountains: On Zhaoyao Mountain lives a beast shaped like an ape with white ears that walks upright. Eating it makes one a swift runner.

lore.zh_CN: 《南山经》：鹿吴之山，泽更之水出焉。有兽焉，名曰蛊雕，其状如雕而有角，其音如婴儿之音，是食人。
lore.en_US: Southern Mountains: The Gudiao looks like an eagle with horns and cries like a human infant. It preys on people.

lore.zh_CN: 《南山经》：青丘之山，有兽焉，其状如狐而九尾，其音如婴儿，能食人；食者不蛊。
lore.en_US: Southern Mountains: On Qingqiu Mountain lives a fox with nine tails that cries like an infant. Its flesh wards off evil poison.

lore.zh_CN: 《西山经》：昆仑之丘，是实惟帝之下都，神陆吾司之。其神状虎身而九尾，人面而虎爪。
lore.en_US: Western Mountains: On the Kunlun mound, the earthly capital of the Divine, dwells the god Luwu — tiger-bodied with nine tails, a human face and tiger claws.

lore.zh_CN: 《西山经》：章莪之山，有鸟焉，其状如鹤而一足，赤文青质而白喙，名曰毕方，见则其邑有讹火。
lore.en_US: Western Mountains: The Bifang is a one-legged crane with crimson markings. Wherever it appears, strange fires break out in the town.

lore.zh_CN: 《北山经》：单张之山，有兽焉，其状如豹而长尾，人首而牛耳，一目，名曰诸犊，善吒，行则衔其尾，居则蟠其尾。
lore.en_US: Northern Mountains: The Zhudu has a leopard's body and long tail, a human head with ox ears and a single eye. It howls fiercely, carrying its tail in its mouth as it walks.

lore.zh_CN: 《东山经》：余峨之山，有兽焉，其状如菟而鸟喙，鸱目蛇尾，见则螽蝗为败。
lore.en_US: Eastern Mountains: The Qiuyu looks like a hare with a bird's beak, an owl's eyes and a snake's tail. Where it appears, locusts ravage the harvest.

lore.zh_CN: 《中山经》：蔓渠之山，有兽焉，其名曰马腹，其状人面虎身，其音如婴儿，是食人。
lore.en_US: Central Mountains: The Mafu has a human face and a tiger's body, and cries like an infant. It preys on people.

lore.zh_CN: 《大荒北经》：共工之臣名曰相繇，九首蛇身，自环，食于九土，所扢之泽即为溪。
lore.en_US: Great Wilderness North: Xiangliu, minister of Gonggong, has nine snake heads and coils upon itself, devouring nine lands. Wherever it passes, land turns to mire.

lore.zh_CN: 《大荒北经》：钟山之神，名曰烛阴，视为昼，瞑为夜，吹为冬，呼为夏，不食不寝不息。
lore.en_US: Great Wilderness North: The spirit of Mount Zhong — when its eyes open it is day, when they close it is night; its breath is winter and summer.
